profile_text.body:
Hesai Group, which presents itself as Hesai Technology, describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and lidar solutions for ADAS and autonomous mobility. According to its website, the company enables physical AI across ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence, and supplies lidar sensors for autonomous vehicles, trucking, robotics, and industrial applications.

The company says it partners with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, and robotics companies worldwide, delivering mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries. Its website states that its lidars provide high-resolution 3D perception for features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot), and that it offers sensors meeting standards for L4+ autonomous driving for robotaxis and robobuses.

Hesai Group is a for-profit public company headquartered in Shanghai. It trades under the ticker HSAI and has SEC CIK 0001861737.
